description: This file contains unit tests for the BatchApiServiceImpl class within the Apache Fineract project. It tests the handling of batch requests, including transaction management, retries, and error handling, by mocking dependencies and verifying expected behaviors.

classes.name: BatchApiServiceImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BatchApiServiceImpl, testing batch request processing behavior.

methods.description: Initializes mocks and test data before each test.
